en: Black-and-white panoramic view of a spa town nestled in wooded hills. In the foreground are multi-story houses with steep, gabled roofs and many windows; one rooftop bears the word "LONDON". Behind them stand ornate, classical spa buildings with domes and colonnades, chimneys, and tree-lined promenades. The town rises up the hillside with grand hotels and a church-like building visible against the forested background. The caption "Marienbad." is printed in red at the top center.
